title: Stroke signs
plain: Sudden weakness, numbness, confusion or slurred speech can be a stroke. Note the time, protect the person and give nothing by mouth.

doNotGive.reason: No aspirin or ibuprofen with stroke signs: they can make a bleed in the brain worse
Nothing by mouth: swallowing may not be safe
Nothing by mouth: swallowing may not be safe

steps.text: Note the time the signs started (or when the person was last seen well).
Call the crew medical officer now.
Measure blood sugar: very low sugar can look like a stroke.
steps.detail: Below 54 mg/dL: also open Low blood sugar (glucagon, nothing by mouth).

steps.text: Measure oxygen. Below 94%: give oxygen by the checklist.
Lie down with the head slightly raised. Nothing to eat or drink.
Stay with the person. Check speech, face and arms every 15 minutes.

escalation: Signs not improving or getting worse: follow EMG-NEURO-SYMPTOMS with the CMO and keep the time of onset. Earth is informed.
